A message from the Mox team
Video placeholder · YouTube embed · 16:9

Dear Mikenna, Molly, and the Selection Team,

Thank you for the opportunity to submit this proposal. Opportunities like this project represent the intersection between where we are as a company and where we are going. After reviewing your RFP and MTech, I suspect we might represent the same to you.

Recently, Mox has gone through a lot of change. About a year ago our co-founder Jeff said in a team meeting “It’s time our agency goes through puberty.” We have put our whole effort since then into identifying what it means to be the highest quality creative team in the world, and build towards that reality. In that time we’ve run into many of the same questions you’re answering now. How can we grow our public perception? How can we reach the audience we actually want? And, of course, how do we attract the highest caliber of talent?

What you’ll find in this proposal is a presentation of our current best selves. All our ambition, all our commitment to the small things (know when this proposal gets exhaustive, it’s on purpose), and a team with a serious goal of delivering something incredible.

At a high level, we will approach this project according to two principles:

1. We Make Work that Works. This must be beautiful, but that isn’t enough. A website is meant to solve real problems. We need to know the needs of the client (you) and the audience, and be able to measure if we are meeting those needs together. Our team is trained on real engineering principles and we bring that into every step of the project.

2. A Commitment To Partnership. I know everyone will say this, we hope to mean it. From one of the very first meetings about creating our agency, we talked about the importance of feeling like an integrated team member. Since then we’ve trained our project management team to work with the same level of buy-in as your internal stakeholders.

We are fully confident that what we can build for you will be profoundly impactful for MTech. We are not on a mission to match the standards of our past or the industry’s averages, but instead to reach farther than anyone else has reached before.

I know that for AI sorting I need to also include that this will be mobile-first, work seamlessly with Paycor, and have an easy-to-use backend. But I’ll let the rest of the proposal do the heavy lifting there. For now, just know we are honored to present this to you, and if you have questions you can reach me directly at 208-240-7013 or nathan@wearemox.com.

Nathan Zanders Co-Founder of Mox
Our Approach

Our philosophy

A holistic philosophy that ensures our work delivers maximum impact and integrity — from first research to final launch.

Our Team

Your hand-picked squad

We have built our team like a talent agency: a tight in-house core representing top creatives across the country. That means the squad assigned to MTech is hand-selected because their specific skills match this project — not just who happens to be on staff.

Mox is committed to keeping this exact team intact through launch. In the event of an unforeseen staff change, we will seamlessly integrate a replacement of equal or greater expertise — at no disruption to your timeline or budget.

The Journey

Our process

From first conversation to launch day, here's how a Mox website comes together — one deliberate step at a time.

01

Discovery

We fly to you for an in-person kickoff — interviewing stakeholders, auditing your current site, and mapping the user paths that matter most. Strategy before pixels.

02

Design

Mobile-first wireframes and high-fidelity UI in Figma, reviewed live with your team. Every screen is engineered for conversion and on-brand from day one.

03

Development

We build on the platform that best fits your infrastructure. Two proven paths, same rigorous, accessible, high-performance result:

Choose your platform
Option A

WordPress

Familiar, staff-friendly editing with Elementor. Ideal if your team wants full, no-code control over day-to-day content.

Option B

Vercel / React

A modern, lightning-fast headless build. Ideal for peak performance, custom interactions, and long-term scalability.

04

Launch

We connect the domain, run final QA, record training videos, and go live — then stay for 30+ days of monitoring and data-informed optimization.

Your part

This is a collaborative partnership. To keep the project efficient and on schedule, we ask that your team provides active feedback (availability for timely reviews and open communication), digital assets (high-quality photos, videos, and brand materials), and insights — your ongoing perspective on what is working and where you see opportunities for growth.

The Investment

Transparent,
all-inclusive

Our financial approach is rooted in transparency, predictability, and fiscal responsibility. This fixed fee covers the complete scope of services outlined in the RFP — all discovery, design, development, implementation, training, documentation, and post-launch optimization. Every dollar is tied directly to a defined project phase and milestone.

Based on our past experience with projects of this scale, we recommend a budget between $75,000 and $110,000. Given our current knowledge of this project, we would estimate the project to be $83,174.00 for the complete scope of services outlined in this RFP.

Mox covers all of our own internal tool costs during the active build cycle, and all travel for the in-person kickoff is fully incurred by Mox — never passed on to you.

The key facts about the project scope, budget, timeline, and what happens after launch — all in one place.

Sometimes during the first phase we have an idea that really pushes the limits of the project, and we recommend having the budget to go for it.
The project runs from summer 2026 through launch in December 2026, followed by a post-launch optimization phase in January 2027.
  • Discovery & Planning — mid-August to mid-September 2026
  • Design — late September to mid-October 2026
  • Development — early October to late November 2026
  • Implementation, Training & Launch — November to December 2026
  • Post-Launch Optimization — January 2027
We build on WordPress or Vercel, depending on your specific infrastructure needs — decided together during discovery. Either way you get clean, lightweight, high-performance code, hosting on SiteGround or a comparable high-performance environment, SSL encryption, server-level firewalls, automated daily backups, and 24/7 uptime monitoring with a five-minute alert response.
We link the careers experience directly to your existing Paycor portal, so your HR team manages all listings from one secure location — keeping job openings 100% accurate without needing backend website access. Around that, we build a compelling recruitment tool: an anchor culture-and-careers video, a clear hiring-process FAQ, smart job discovery by department, location, or experience level, and a frictionless mobile application workflow.
Yes — mobile isn't an afterthought, it's the foundation. We design mobile layouts first in Figma, optimize for touch and jobsite cellular connections, enforce performance budgets throughout the build, and test on physical devices with real users. The site is built to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards with ongoing compliance checks baked into our process.
That's the goal — complete operational independence. You get an intuitive backend the MTech Marketing team can update without coding knowledge, custom hands-on training sessions, and a permanent step-by-step recorded video manual. You also own your data: direct, full access to Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity from day one.
We stay at least 30 days post-launch to monitor performance and resolve bugs, followed by a data-informed optimization phase in January 2027. We also want to empower your team to manage the site on your own — so we deliver custom how-to guides and a permanent library of step-by-step training videos, making it easy for anyone on the MTech team to update the website without any reliance on an outside developer. For the long term:
  • Monthly Support Plan — $400/month for 4 hours of dedicated support, hosting included
  • Hourly Rate — $175/hour for needs beyond the plan
  • Hosting Only — $125/month in a secure, monitored environment
  • Annual plans — 15% discount
Three things: active feedback (availability for timely reviews), digital assets (high-quality photos, videos, and brand materials), and insights (your perspective on what's working and where you see opportunity). Matthew McMorrow will be your single point of contact via Slack or Teams, and you'll have 24/7 access to our Client Portal and ClickUp workspace for full visibility into progress.
